description: This Java source file defines a class `ThingsConditionalHeadersValidatorProvider` that provides a singleton `ConditionalHeadersValidator` for validating conditional HTTP headers on 'Thing' resources, with specific handling logic for exempted fields such as `_policy`. It contains inner classes for validation settings and logic to skip checks based on command type and selected fields.

classes.name: ThingsConditionalHeadersValidatorProvider
classes.description: Provides a singleton instance of a conditional headers validator for 'Thing' resources, with logic to skip validation based on command-specific field selections.
